arxiv-2109-00830.title: Arithmetic statistics and Diophantine Stability for Elliptic Curves
arxiv-2109-00830.creator: Anwesh Ray
arxiv-2109-00830.description: Abstract . We study the growth and stability of the Mordell-Weil group and Tate-Shafarevich group of an elliptic curve defined over the rationals, in various cyclic Galois extensions of prime power order. Mazur and Rubin introduced the notion of diophantine stability for the Mordell-Weil group an elliptic curve E / ℚ E_{/{\mathbb{Q}}} at a given prime p p .

arxiv-2110-00573.title: Effects of nonmagnetic impurities and subgap states on the kinetic inductance, complex conductivity, quality factor and depairing current density
arxiv-2110-00573.creator: Takayuki Kubo
arxiv-2110-00573.description: Abstract We investigate how a combination of a nonmagnetic-impurity scattering rate γ \gamma and finite subgap states parametrized by Dynes Γ \Gamma affects various physical quantities relevant to to superconducting devices: kinetic inductance L k L_{k} , complex conductivity σ \sigma , surface resistance R s R_{s} , quality factor Q Q , and depairing current density J d J_{d}

arxiv-2210-05533.title: Style-Guided Inference of Transformer for High-resolution Image Synthesis
arxiv-2210-05533.creator: Jonghwa Yim, Minjae Kim
arxiv-2210-05533.description: Abstract Transformer is eminently suitable for auto-regressive image synthesis which predicts discrete value from the past values recursively to make up full image. Especially, combined with vector quantised latent representation, the state-of-the-art auto-regressive transformer displays realistic high-resolution images. However, sampling the latent code from discrete probability distribution makes the output unpredictable.

arxiv-2303-10224.title: A Hybrid 3D/2D Field Response Calculation for Liquid Argon Detectors with PCB Based Anode Plane
arxiv-2303-10224.creator: and F. Dolek
arxiv-2303-10224.description: Abstract Liquid Argon Time Projection Chamber (LArTPC) technology is commonly utilized in neutrino detector designs. It enables detailed reconstruction of neutrino events with high spatial precision and low energy threshold. Its field response (FR) model describes the time-dependent electric currents induced in the anode-plane electrodes when ionization electrons drift nearby.

arxiv-2308-03515.title: Keyword Spotting Simplified: A Segmentation-Free Approach using Character Counting and CTC re-scoring
arxiv-2308-03515.creator: George Retsinas, Giorgos Sfikas, Christophoros Nikou
arxiv-2308-03515.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by George Retsinas, Giorgos Sfikas, Christophoros Nikou. Recent advances in segmentation-free keyword spotting borrow from state-of-the-art object detection systems to simultaneously propose a word bounding box proposal mechanism and compute a corresponding representation. Contrary to the norm of such methods that rely on complex and large DNN models, we propose a novel segmentation-free system that efficiently scans a document image to find rectangular areas that include the query information.

arxiv-2402-08090.title: Learning Neural Contracting Dynamics: Extended Linearization and Global Guarantees
arxiv-2402-08090.creator: Sean Jaffe, Alexander Davydov, Deniz Lapsekili, Ambuj K. Singh, Francesco Bullo
arxiv-2402-08090.description: Abstract Global stability and robustness guarantees in learned dynamical systems are essential to ensure well-behavedness of the systems in the face of uncertainty. We present Extended Linearized Contracting Dynamics (ELCD), the first neural network-based dynamical system with global contractivity guarantees in arbitrary metrics. The key feature of ELCD is a parametrization of the extended linearization of the nonlinear vector field.

arxiv-2503-03688.title: A model for boundary-driven tissue morphogenesis
arxiv-2503-03688.creator: Daniel S. Alber, Shiheng Zhao, Alexandre O. Jacinto, Eric F. Wieschaus, Stanislav Y. Shvartsman, Pierre A. Haas
arxiv-2503-03688.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Daniel S. Alber, Shiheng Zhao, Alexandre O. Jacinto, Eric F. Wieschaus, Stanislav Y. Shvartsman, Pierre A. Haas. Tissue deformations during morphogenesis can be active, driven by internal processes, or passive, resulting from stresses applied at their boundaries. Here, we introduce the Drosophila hindgut primordium as a model for studying boundary-driven tissue morphogenesis. We characterize its deformations and show that its complex shape changes can be a passive consequence of the deformations of the active regions of the embryo that surround it.

arxiv-2504-21089.title: Extracting average properties of disordered spin chains with translationally invariant tensor networks
arxiv-2504-21089.creator: Kevin Vervoort, Wei Tang, Nick Bultinck
arxiv-2504-21089.description: Abstract We develop a tensor network-based method for calculating disorder-averaged expectation values in random spin chains without having to explicitly sample over disorder configurations. The algorithm exploits statistical translation invariance and works directly in the thermodynamic limit. We benchmark our method on the infinite-randomness critical point of the random transverse field Ising model.

arxiv-2505-13993.title: Conglomerates, Liquidity Shocks, and Innovation-Led Growth Working Paper – May 2025
arxiv-2505-13993.creator: Payne Hennigan
arxiv-2505-13993.description: Abstract I develop a dynamic model of how internal capital markets in conglomerates respond to liquidity shocks when affiliated firms vary in innovation potential. A two-stage framework defines cutoff rules for when the conglomerate should liquidate low-productivity firms, coerce intermediate types into short-termist strategies, or preserve high-potential firms for long-horizon R&D.

arxiv-2507-08186.title: Ratio limits and pressure function for group extensions of Gibbs Markov maps
arxiv-2507-08186.creator: Jaime Gomez, Dalia Terhesiu
arxiv-2507-08186.description: Abstract . Ratio limit theorems for random walks on (various) groups are known. We obtain a generalization of this type of ratio limit for deterministic walks on certain groups driven by Gibbs Markov maps. In terms of proofs, the main difficulty comes down to the absence of a convolution structure.

arxiv-2512-19708.title: ON THE PROBLEM OF SIMPLE SHEAR OF AN INCOMPRESSIBLE VISCOELASTIC SOLID UNDER FINITE DEFORMATIONS
arxiv-2512-19708.creator: Vladislav V. Kozhukhov
arxiv-2512-19708.description: Abstract In the framework of a viscoelastic material model, whose constitutive relation is given by a one-parameter family of Gordon–Schowalter derivatives, the problem of simple shear under acceleration and random velocity motion is considered. For motion with acceleration, the presence of non-zero normal stresses is discovered, which corresponds to the Poynting effect previously discovered for this material.

arxiv-2601-16089.title: A forward-only scheme for online learning of proposal distributions in particle filters
arxiv-2601-16089.creator: Sylvain Procope-Mamert, Nicolas Chopin, Maud Delattre, Guillaume Kon Kam King
arxiv-2601-16089.description: Abstract We introduce a new online approach for constructing proposal distributions in particle filters using a forward scheme. Our method progressively incorporates future observations to refine proposals. This is in contrast to backward-scheme algorithms that require access to the entire dataset, such as the iterated auxiliary particle filters ( Guarniero et al.

arxiv-2601-19912.creator: Duo Chai, Zizhen Liu, Shuhuai Wang, Songwei Pei, Cheng Liu
arxiv-2601-19912.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are highly compute- and memory-intensive, posing significant demands on high-performance GPUs. At the same time, advances in GPU technology driven by shrinking transistor sizes and lower operating voltages have made these devices increasingly susceptible to soft errors.

pmc-10704840.title: Cesena guidelines: WSES consensus statement on laparoscopic-first approach to general surgery emergencies and abdominal trauma
pmc-10704840.creator: Giacomo Sermonesi, Brian W. C. A. Tian, Carlo Vallicelli, Fikri M. Abu‑Zidan, Dimitris Damaskos, Michael Denis Kelly, Ari Leppäniemi, Joseph M. Galante, Edward Tan, Andrew W. Kirkpatrick, Vladimir Khokha, Oreste Marco Romeo, Mircea Chirica, Manos Pikoulis, Andrey Litvin, Vishal Girishchandra Shelat,
pmc-10704840.description: BackgroundLaparoscopy is widely adopted across nearly all surgical subspecialties in the elective setting. Initially finding indication in minor abdominal emergencies, it has gradually become the standard approach in the majority of elective general surgery procedures. Despite many technological advances and increasing acceptance, the laparoscopic approach remains underutilized in emergency general surgery and in abdominal trauma.

pmc-11516422.title: Cardiovascular diseases risk assessment: the Italian Health Examination Survey 2023 - CUORE Project
pmc-11516422.creator: C Donfrancesco, C Lo Noce, A Di Lonardo, B Marcozzi, S Vannucchi, M Morello, S Bernardini, D Galeone, P Bellisario, L Palmieri
pmc-11516422.description: BackgroundThe reduction of NCDs premature mortality is pursued by the WHO; risk conditions targets are recommended as well as population-level monitoring of cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk. The Italian Ministry of Health (MoH) has strengthened prevention/health promotion and supported periodic CVD risk assessment through national health examination surveys (HESs), funded by the MoH-CCM and conducted within the CUORE Project.

pmc-11545862.title: Convergence of Neuroinflammation, Microbiota, and Parkinson’s Disease: Therapeutic Insights and Prospects
pmc-11545862.creator: Nerea Domínguez Rojo, Mercedes Blanco Benítez, Ramón Cava, José Manuel Fuentes, Saray Canales Cortés, Rosa Ana González Polo, Laura Giannotti, Luisa Siculella
pmc-11545862.description: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a complex neurodegenerative disorder. Recent evidence reveals connections between neuroinflammatory processes and intestinal microbiota alterations in the progression of this pathology. This comprehensive review explores the intricate relationships between them, highlighting their combined impact on PD.

pmc-12384631.title: Spatially Encoded Oncogenesis and Transcriptional Plasticity in Meningioma: Drivers of Therapeutic Resistance and Opportunities for Targeted Intervention
pmc-12384631.creator: Matthew A Abikenari, Amit Regev, Brandon H Bergsneider, Vratko Himic, Shreyas Annagiri, Lily H Kim, Ravi Medikonda, John Choi, Sanjeeva Jeyaretna, Daniel M Fountain, Michael Lim, Hiroaki Wakimoto, Yasin Temel
pmc-12384631.description: Simple SummaryMeningiomas are common brain tumors, but a subset behaves aggressively and resists current treatments. This review proposes a developmentally informed framework showing that where a meningioma arises in the skull mirrors its embryologic origin (neural crest vs. mesoderm) and imprints distinct genetic, epigenetic, and immune programs that shape tumor behavior and treatment response.

pmc-12558104.title: The HIV Epidemic in the United States – Epidemiological Projections and Public Economic Impact of Achieving Zero Transmission Goals
pmc-12558104.creator: Cillian Copeland, Rui Martins, Ryan Thaliffdeen, Nikos Kotsopoulos, James Jarrett, Paresh Chaudhari, Uche Mordi, Maarten J Postma
pmc-12558104.description: BackgroundThe United States (US) HIV/AIDS strategy has targeted a 90% reduction in HIV infections by 2030. Whilst progress has been made in US HIV policy, the persistence of nearly 32,000 new infections annually highlights substantial barriers that still hinder effective treatment and the achievement of national targets.

pmc-13204651.title: Akkermansia muciniphila and Alzheimer’s Disease: Mechanisms, Evidence and Translational Potential
pmc-13204651.creator: Jun Li, Qiushuang Long, Binglin Zhu
pmc-13204651.description: Akkermansia muciniphila (A. muciniphila) is a bacterium that breaks down mucus and is studied for its effects on metabolism and the immune system. Studies show that it affects Alzheimer’s disease (AD) by protecting the gut barrier, reducing inflammation, and influencing communication between the immune system, the brain, and mitochondria. This review summarizes mechanistic, preclinical, and translational evidence connecting A.

pmc-13279376.title: Drug-coated balloons in coronary in-stent restenosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis comparing sirolimus and biolimus with paclitaxel platforms
pmc-13279376.creator: Mrunalini Dandamudi, Muhammad Aqib Faizan, Tooba Rehman, Caterina Lecchi, Manoj Ghimire, Jyothik Varun Inampudi, John Cedric Mojica, Salomon Chamay, Juliana Giorgi
pmc-13279376.description: Background Coronary in-stent restenosis (ISR) remains a relevant clinical challenge despite advances in drug-eluting stent technology. Drug-coated balloons (DCBs) offer a metal-free revascularization option, with microtubule stabilizer drug – paclitaxel coated balloons (PCBs) being the most validated. The m-TOR inhibitors drugs like Sirolimus and Biolimus coated balloons (SCBs, BCBs) have emerged as alternatives, but comparative efficacy and safety remain uncertain.

pmc-13299518.title: Evaluation of Steinernema khuongi and Heterorhabditis downesi as Biological Control Agents Against Four Stored Product Beetle Pests
pmc-13299518.creator: Angeliki Maria N. Matzavaki, Maria C. Boukouvala, Anna Skourti, Demeter Lorentha S. Gidari, Dionysios Ntinokas, Alexandros Dritsoulas, Ioannis O. Giannakou, Nickolas G. Kavallieratos
pmc-13299518.description: Simple SummaryInsects attacking stored products cause considerable economic losses worldwide through degradation of their quality and quantity. The need for sustainable control methods of noxious insect species in storages leads to the examination of entomopathogenic nematodes (EPNs) as alternatives to chemical insecticides.

pmc-13300393.title: Safety profile of ajmaline testing in Brugada syndrome: influence of SCNA5 mutations
pmc-13300393.creator: N Drapier, J Gourraud, D Therasse, P Petit, V Cotard, A Thollet, B Pierre, N Behar, J Mansourati, F Sacher, G Clerici, V Probst
pmc-13300393.description: BackgroundSodium channel blocker (SCB) testing is a key diagnostic tool for Brugada syndrome (BrS), but it carries a non-negligible risk of complications.
